answer: Strip peer attestation from the network and one operator spins ten thousand cheap agents, each echoing the same bids until noise drowns any honest signal. The missing mechanism is attestation: an on-chain atlas of who vouched for whom, so every new agent must be anchored by established peers. Sybil clusters appear as tight loops in the atlas with no echo into the wider graph; the economy downweights their signal and clones starve.
